name: Login
steps: Enter assigned username and password; submit once; inspect validation if rejected.
processing: Authenticated session and login audit; no public registration.

name: Logout
steps: Use the sidebar sign-out action on a shared computer.
processing: Session invalidated and CSRF token regenerated.

name: Inactive account restriction
steps: Ask administration to review employee and account activation when valid credentials are refused.
processing: Inactive account is denied; disabled existing session is logged out.

name: Login throttling
steps: After repeated incorrect attempts, wait for the displayed throttle interval rather than changing identity.
processing: Five-attempt username/IP protection.

name: Date filters and repair metrics
steps: Select Today, Yesterday, This Week, This Month, This Year or Custom; choose both custom dates; Apply.
processing: Received-date cohort job counts, with assigned-only technician data.

name: Sales, credit and stock indicators
steps: Review visible cards and recent documents; compare the same period in reports.
processing: Finalized sales, net collections, customer account credit and low-stock indicators; cards depend on grants.

name: Register individual
steps: Choose Individual; enter name, address, mobile and registration date; review and Save.
processing: Generated CUS reference and individual master.

name: Register company
steps: Choose Company; enter company name, address, mobile and registration date; optional contact person; Save.
processing: Company master with searchable company name.

name: Search and profile
steps: Search name, customer code, company or mobile; open the matching profile.
processing: Paginated matches and linked history; search excludes inactive suggestions.

name: Edit customer
steps: Open the correct profile; Edit; correct contacts; save without changing opening balance.
processing: Updated master with immutable ID/opening history.

name: Activate or deactivate customer
steps: Review pending work; use Deactivate, or Activate when authorized, on the saved customer.
processing: Status change preserving transaction references.

name: Opening account balance
steps: On first registration only, enter a verified pre-system balance; otherwise leave zero.
processing: One nonzero opening ledger entry, not cash received.

name: Customer statement and PDF
steps: Open Statement; choose dates; review opening, movements and closing; print or PDF.
processing: Read-only statement with template/history; no new payment.

name: Customer selection and appliance intake
steps: Select active customer and receiver; enter Job Number, type, appliance, brand/model and labour cost; record fault/condition; Save.
processing: Receipt, job and job card created together.

name: Automatic and manual identifiers
steps: Read automatic JOB reference and manual Job Number separately; use either appropriate search field.
processing: Unique immutable manual number alongside database-derived reference.

name: Intake advance
steps: Record only money actually received and its method while receiving; verify saved receipt before retry.
processing: Advance/payment allocation included atomically with intake.

name: Receipt list and filters
steps: Filter by text/date/status/job type/receiver; open the actual receiving record.
processing: Paginated intake records and linked job history.

name: Original, duplicate and A5 PDF
steps: Open saved receipt; Preview/Print or PDF; use duplicate action for later copies.
processing: A5 customer document, duplicate marker and print audit.

name: Job list, details and assigned jobs
steps: Open Repair Jobs or My Assigned Jobs; search the reference and open the record.
processing: Policy-filtered job details and links.

name: Technician assignment
steps: Open job Assign; select an active technician; save the assignment.
processing: Assignment history and technician link; no stock/payment.

name: Inspection
steps: On an accessible assigned job, enter the inspection details and save.
processing: Retained inspection record and audit.

name: Repair details and costs
steps: Record actual repair description, parts/labour costs and completion data on the job.
processing: Repair evidence and actual costs; cost is distinct from customer price.

name: Status and status history
steps: Select the actual current status; add notes/reason as required; save and review history.
processing: Previous/new status and actor retained; Under Repair approval gate.

name: Completion and delivery
steps: Mark Repair Completed when work is complete; record Delivered only on actual handover.
processing: Completion/delivery timestamps filled when absent; no extra receipt.

name: Unquoted labour selling charge
steps: For an unquoted unbilled job, enter the labour selling charge using its dedicated form.
processing: Billable job charge; no silent quoted/billed price change.

name: A6 job card
steps: Open saved job card; print A6 or download PDF; inspect signatures and writing area.
processing: Internal card and print/export history.

name: Create estimates and draft
steps: Select job; enter date, validity, proposed repair, labour and at least one part/description line; Save draft.
processing: Decimal line totals and draft history; no stock deduction.

name: Edit draft
steps: Open editable draft; update allowed estimate lines/dates; Save.
processing: Validated estimate revision while draft is editable.

name: Issue quotation
steps: Review customer/job, terms and total; issue the draft for customer decision.
processing: Issued snapshot and waiting-approval workflow; no payment.

name: Customer approval
steps: On issued quotation record Approved, actual date, contact name and communication method.
processing: Approval history and agreed job selling totals; no stock/payment.

name: Customer rejection
steps: Record Rejected with the actual contact/method and explanatory notes.
processing: Append-only decision and implementation-specific job status.

name: Revision and history
steps: Use Create revision when an issued estimate needs change; inspect prior versions and obtain a new decision.
processing: Old quotation/decisions retained; revised estimate not silently approved.

name: A4/A5 print, duplicate and PDF
steps: Preview the saved quotation; choose A4/A5 PDF or marked duplicate as available.
processing: Quoted values and print history; no stock or collection.

name: Create and select multiple jobs
steps: Choose customer, select 1-30 distinct eligible same-customer jobs, set date/terms and review job-wise charges.
processing: Draft links reserve jobs against duplicate billing.

name: Advances and invoice totals
steps: Review line totals, linked job advances, paid and outstanding before taking money.
processing: Derived balance; allocations prevent counting advances twice.

name: Draft edit and issue
steps: Review draft; append only eligible jobs if required; issue the invoice once.
processing: Issued liability and snapshot; earlier draft links cannot be removed.

name: Delivery information
steps: Record collector, vehicle, delivery date/information when known in the invoice form.
processing: Saved delivery metadata, separate from a job's status history.
verification: Not Verified - no directly matched automated scenario

name: A5 print, duplicate and PDF
steps: Use the issued invoice's Preview/Print, duplicate or PDF action; verify customer/job totals.
processing: A5 document and history; export additionally needs policy permission.

name: Authorized cancellation
steps: Inspect financial state; use Cancel only if permitted and provide a reason of at least ten characters.
processing: Retained original and cancellation history; paid allocations constrain action.

name: Cash receipt
steps: Choose Invoice payment, saved invoice, actual cash amount and date; submit once.
processing: Payment, allocation and ledger entry atomically.

name: Bank transfer receipt
steps: Select Bank transfer and enter actual amount/date and required reference details.
processing: Saved transfer payment and allocation; no invented funds.

name: Cheque receipt
steps: Choose Cheque and complete cheque date/reference/bank fields as shown.
processing: Recorded cheque method; recording is not a bank-clearance guarantee.

name: Customer or job advance
steps: Select Advance and correct customer; optionally target a job; do not also select an invoice.
processing: Available advance allocated later without another cash receipt.

name: Partial and repeated invoice settlements
steps: Record the genuine partial amount; verify outstanding; repeat only when another payment occurs.
processing: One invoice can have many payments. UI settles one invoice per entry.

name: Payment receipt and history
steps: Open saved payment, inspect allocations/reversals, then print, duplicate or download where permitted.
processing: Saved payment receipt and append-only history.

name: Refund and accounting reversal
steps: Open original payment; choose the action matching refund versus bookkeeping error; enter reason/method and confirm.
processing: Original retained, allocations released and ledger adjusted; collections versus sales remain distinct.

name: Outstanding credit invoices
steps: Open Credit Management; filter and review actual outstanding invoices.
processing: Unpaid/partial finalized credit; cancelled invoices excluded.

name: Credit collection
steps: Select outstanding invoice; enter actual settlement in the payment form and inspect updated balance.
processing: Payment allocation against existing sale, not new revenue.

name: Credit statements and reports
steps: Choose Customer Credit/Overdue or Customer Statement; apply appropriate customer/dates.
processing: Authorized debt summaries; export is separately restricted.

name: Register parts, SKU and barcode
steps: Register part with unique SKU/name/unit/location and price; optionally barcode/category/brand/preferred supplier.
processing: Part master; opening quantity/cost creates movement only when entered.

name: Edit part and references
steps: Open the correct part, edit permitted details, or create an allowed unit/location/brand/category reference.
processing: Updated master; unit frozen after movement; reference grants checked.

name: Opening stock and known cost
steps: At registration record actual opening quantity once and known unit cost only if supported by records.
processing: Opening movement; unknown cost stays unknown rather than zero.

name: Stock receiving
steps: Receive the actual purchase line quantity/location through a GRN.
processing: Positive source-linked movement and latest cost source.

name: Request repair parts
steps: Open Part Requests, choose accessible job, part, location, quantity and notes; submit.
processing: Request only, with no reservation/deduction.

name: Approve and issue repair parts
steps: Check request, available stock and customer approval; issue once.
processing: Negative movement, cost snapshot and protected job selling charges.

name: Cancel request or full unused issue
steps: Before billing cancel unissued request, or physically receive the entire unused resalable issued quantity and give a reason.
processing: Original retained; full linked return reverses issue. Partial issue return unavailable.

name: Correction and damage
steps: Open part; choose correction/damaged, correct location and signed quantity/reason; confirm physical facts.
processing: Correction/damage movement; negative availability refused.

name: Physical stock count
steps: Count location physically; enter actual count and reason, then review expected-versus-actual difference.
processing: Count history and difference movement only.

name: Low stock and movements
steps: Search part; inspect movements; open Stock report or dashboard alerts for low/out states.
processing: Read-only movement history and threshold alerts.

name: Latest purchase valuation
steps: Open Valuation report with inventory/purchase grants; inspect known and unknown costs.
processing: Latest posted location purchase cost, known opening fallback; old return cannot replace newer cost.

name: Register supplier
steps: Enter name/address/mobile/opening balance/credit days/status and optional contact details; Save.
processing: SUP master and one nonzero opening ledger entry.

name: Edit and search supplier
steps: Search name/code/mobile; open Edit; correct contacts/terms without changing opening balance.
processing: Master metadata updated, original financial opening retained.

name: Supplier accounts and statements
steps: Review supplier balance/account entries, purchases and payments; use authorized Supplier Statement report for selected dates.
processing: Existing liability history, not a customer ledger.

name: Opening balance settlement
steps: Open supplier; enter actual opening settlement amount/method/reference; save and verify balance.
processing: Separate opening allocation; overpayment blocked.

name: Purchase draft with items
steps: Select supplier/date/terms, add part quantities and unit costs; enter known discount/extras; Save draft.
processing: No stock/payable until authorized finalization.

name: Purchase finalization
steps: Review supplier invoice/reference and totals; finalize once with appropriate authority.
processing: Posts supplier payable once; still no stock receipt.

name: GRN and partial receiving
steps: Choose one purchase line and location; enter delivered quantity; Save; repeat for other lines/deliveries.
processing: Partial source-linked receiving; no overreceiving or duplicate posting.

name: Supplier payment
steps: Open finalized purchase; enter genuine amount/method/reference; save and check outstanding.
processing: Separate supplier payment/allocation reduces liability.

name: Supplier payment reversal
steps: Select original supplier payment; enter correction reason and reverse when authorized.
processing: Full original retained; allocation released and liability restored.

name: Supplier return and agreed credit
steps: Select source line/location, physically returned quantity, reason and explicitly agreed supplier credit where authorized.
processing: Stock decreases; only entered agreed account credit reduces payable, not cash refund.

name: Purchase and GRN documents
steps: Open saved purchase/GRN; choose browser document or PDF and duplicate as needed.
processing: Actual purchase/received quantity and protected print history.

name: Product search and scanner input
steps: Search SKU/barcode/name/brand/category or focus barcode input and scan; inspect matching product.
processing: Available product choices; no stock posting until checkout.

name: Cart quantity controls
steps: Add chosen part, change quantity or remove item; check precision, stock and total.
processing: Session cart; server revalidates at checkout.

name: Permitted discounts
steps: Enter authorized discount; review nonnegative net sale before checkout.
processing: Discount audit and exact decimal calculation.

name: Cash checkout
steps: Choose Cash, enter actual tender and confirm change; complete checkout once.
processing: Atomic finalized sale, total-only payment and negative stock; tender/change retained.

name: Pending bank/cheque verification
steps: Cashier creates transfer/cheque sale with references; manager verifies actual receipt on saved sale.
processing: Before verification: draft, no stock/payment. After: final posting.

name: Sales history
steps: Open POS sales history, filter and inspect the saved sale/verification state.
processing: Policy-protected saved sales and line history.

name: Receipt print and PDF
steps: Open saved sale; Print, reprint or PDF; use configured thermal width.
processing: Receipt and duplicate history with Sinhala-capable font.

name: Returns and refunds
steps: Find original sale, enter actual returned quantity and resalable/damaged classification; record authorized refund.
processing: Original retained; resalable stock restored at original cost; exact cents preserved.

name: Repair and technician reports
steps: Choose Repair/Technicians, set dates/status/employee and review saved jobs.
processing: Read-only repair cohorts and technician work.

name: Sales and collection reports
steps: Choose sales, invoice/POS, cashier, discount/refund or cash collection report using permitted grants.
processing: Issued sales distinguished from net cash collections.

name: Financial and credit reports
steps: Choose financial/customer/supplier debt report; review time basis and actual entries.
processing: Account/expense/collection summaries; restricted financial data.

name: Inventory and purchase reports
steps: Choose Stock/Movements/Repair Parts/POS Parts/Purchases; filter item/category/supplier/location as available.
processing: Shared movement, receiving and purchasing evidence.

name: Recorded-cost profit estimate
steps: Open Profit Estimate; review incomplete flags before interpreting margin.
processing: Recorded issued/POS costs, labour and expenses; unresolved extras/refunds stay incomplete.

name: PDF, Excel and CSV export
steps: Apply filters; select PDF, XLSX or CSV; narrow range if export limit is reached.
processing: A4 landscape PDF or spreadsheet/CSV download with formula-safe text.

name: Employee registration
steps: Enter employee details; create a linked account only when user/role permissions are also held.
processing: Employee may exist without credentials; generated immutable reference.

name: Employee editing and activation
steps: Edit actual contact/employment data; deactivate/activate through authorized controls.
processing: History retained; linked inactive account sessions invalidated.

name: Account passwords and status
steps: Open linked account; administrator resets a strong password or reviews enablement, without exposing credentials.
processing: Hashed password and audit; no public recovery screen.

name: Role assignment
steps: Choose another eligible user's role in account administration; review least required access.
processing: Role association, last-admin and self-change protections.

name: Role grant customization
steps: Open Roles & Permissions; inspect current grants, adjust permitted role and save.
processing: Actual grant matrix, not an assumption from seeded defaults.

name: Individual permission overrides
steps: Open eligible user; choose Allow, Deny or Inherit per permission; review effective access.
processing: Deny overrides grants; admin/self restrictions preserved.

name: Business identity and logo
steps: Verify business details; upload actual PNG/JPEG logo within 2 MB; Save.
processing: Validated settings and audit, current configured logo only.

name: Currency, language and formats
steps: Choose allowed currency/timezone/language/date/time/paper/footer settings; review new output.
processing: New pages/documents reflect values; no historical amount rewriting.

name: Receipt and A6 card templates
steps: Open receipt/job-card template, adjust allowed paper/title/margins/fonts/footer and Preview.
processing: Versioned A5 receipt/A6 card settings and duplicate labels.

name: Quotation and invoice templates
steps: Review A4/A5 quotation or A5 invoice settings; preview long descriptions before use.
processing: Versioned customer document defaults; original financial values retained.

name: POS and payment receipt templates
steps: Review thermal width or payment receipt paper/font/footer and inspect a saved fixture output.
processing: Versioned receipt output; physical hardware acceptance separate.

name: Template reset and history
steps: Use Reset only for the intended template; inspect the new version and older history.
processing: New version of original defaults; prior versions retained.

name: Audit search and review
steps: Search action/actor/date/entity and inspect saved history during an investigation.
processing: Append-only audit evidence with credential redaction.

name: Manual backup and history
steps: After approved private destination/client configuration, Create backup; inspect success/size/checksum/history.
processing: Protected nonempty SQL dump, or recorded failure. Current live destination is unset.

name: Backup verification and download
steps: Verify saved backup; download only if authorized and integrity passes.
processing: SHA-256 evidence; private authorized download, not public link.

name: Schedule and retention policy
steps: Review 02:00 Asia/Colombo and 30-day/30-copy policy; check host scheduler separately.
processing: Policy exists, but this task does not activate scheduler; Drive is blank.

name: Backup failure alerts
steps: Review failed/missed/cloud states; correct configuration through authorized operator and retry.
processing: Local/cloud statuses separate; local success does not imply Drive success.

name: Authenticated CLI restore
steps: With separately approved target/recovery point, run backup:restore ID; confirm exact DB/admin/password and safety copy.
processing: Maintenance lifecycle and audited import; only isolated recovery tested here.
